quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: Solstice's order rates have surpassed its existing production capacity for certain key product lines. Capital expenditures incurred were $408 million in 2025 (capital expenditures representing 10% of net sales) versus $296 million in 2024, and are expected to be between $400 million and $425 million in 2026; the increase in 2025 and expected 2026 capex is primarily driven by projects to support new products and solutions for its electronic materials and advanced fiber offerings. Electronic & Specialty Materials segment capex was $173 million in 2025 versus $63 million in 2024.
